American Eagle offers the only regularly scheduled service for Lawton, with daily flights to and from Dallas/Fort Worth. 

[[Continental Airlines]] flew to Lawton from 1948 until 1975, with [[DC-9]]s starting in 1967. [[Central Airlines]] served the city starting in 1953-54; successor [[Frontier Airlines (1950–1986)|Frontier Airlines]] served it until 1981.
